title.en: State the rules for assigning oxidation numbers
Calculate oxidation numbers in molecules and ions
Define oxidation and reduction as change in oxidation number

say.en: In covalent molecules like water no electron is fully transferred. Oxidation numbers are a bookkeeping trick that lets us track electrons anyway. In this lesson: State the rules for assigning oxidation numbers.
Calculate oxidation numbers in molecules and ions.
Define oxidation and reduction as change in oxidation number.
Use Stock notation.

body.en: An element in the free state has *oxidation number* 0. A monatomic ion has its charge. Oxygen is usually −2, but −1 in peroxides, −½ in superoxides and +2 in OF₂. Hydrogen is +1, but −1 in metal hydrides such as NaH. Fluorine is always −1. The oxidation numbers in a neutral compound add up to zero, and in an ion to its charge.
body.kn: ಮುಕ್ತ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯ ಧಾತುವಿಗೆ ಉತ್ಕರ್ಷಣ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ 0. ಆಕ್ಸಿಜನ್ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ −2, ಹೈಡ್ರೋಜನ್ +1, ಫ್ಲೋರಿನ್ ಸದಾ −1. ತಟಸ್ಥ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊತ್ತ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಅಯಾನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅದರ ಆವೇಶ.

say.en: H: plus 1 (minus 1 in NaH, CaH 2).
Alkali metals plus 1, alkaline earth metals plus 2.
Sum equals 0 molecule or the charge ion.
The rules: an element on its own is zero; fluorine is always minus one; oxygen is usually minus two; hydrogen usually plus one; and they all add up to the charge.
Potassium dichromate: two potassiums at plus one, two chromiums at x, seven oxygens at minus two, adding to zero. So chromium is plus 6.
Sulphuric acid gives sulphur plus 6. In the ammonium ion, x plus 4 equals plus 1, so nitrogen is minus 3.
Oxidation numbers can be fractions when they are averages. In Fe3O4, 3x equals 8, so x is plus 8 over 3: really one Fe2 plus and two Fe3 plus.

title.en: Redox in terms of oxidation number

body.en: Oxidation is an increase in *oxidation number*; reduction is a decrease. Oxidation numbers can be fractional when they are averages, as in Fe₃O₄ (+8/3). Stock notation writes the oxidation number of a metal in Roman numerals: FeCl₃ is iron(III) chloride.
body.kn: ಉತ್ಕರ್ಷಣ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ಉತ್ಕರ್ಷಣ, ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾದರೆ ಅಪಕರ್ಷಣ. ಸರಾಸರಿಯಾದಾಗ ಉತ್ಕರ್ಷಣ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಭಿನ್ನರಾಶಿಯೂ ಆಗಬಹುದು. ಸ್ಟಾಕ್ ಸಂಕೇತದಲ್ಲಿ ರೋಮನ್ ಅಂಕಿ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

problem.en: Find the oxidation number of Cr in K₂Cr₂O₇ and of P in H₂PO₄⁻.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the oxidation number of Cr in K₂Cr₂O₇ and of P in H₂PO₄⁻.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find the oxidation number of Cr in K 2Cr 2O 7 and of P in H 2PO 4⁻.
K 2Cr 2O 7: 2plus 1 plus 2x plus 7minus 2 equals 0 so 2x equals 12 so x = plus 6.
H 2PO 4⁻: 2plus 1 plus x plus 4minus 2 equals minus 1 so x minus 6 equals minus 1 so x = plus 5.
So the answer is Cr = plus 6; P = plus 5.
